float_policy: Source vertices are binary32. Each world coordinate converted to Python float before min/max subtraction. Constraints are tested exactly against frozen bounds, with no blanket tolerance or altered freeze; all margin deltas reported. Ray-start epsilon is geometric query robustness only, never dimension allowance.
visibility_limit: Every component is tested against the complete transformed mesh with actual triangle-centroid outward rays; positive samples establish geometric exposure, not pixel-scale recognizability. Pixel review is separate.
